title: [AINews] Gemini 4 Carbon tops leaderboards, launches for cyber defenders
author: swyx .ai
description: Google’s new frontier model leads independent evals, with access initially limited to trusted defenders.
summary: It’s a good thing we published our Opus 5.5 podcast calling it the world’s best model before today’s launch. We checked 12 subreddits, 544 Twitters and no further Discords.
takeaways: Lab gap : scaling01 thinks Google remains about two months behind the next OpenAI and Anthropic releases ( @scaling01 ).
